texts.facts: In anticipation of arrest in Crime No.408 of 2021 registered with Patur Police Station, District Akola for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 30(2)(a), 3(1)(zz)(v), 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, the applicant/accused is seeking for pre-arrest protection. 3. It is primely canvassed that the applicant's name is neither mentioned in the First Information Report nor there is any material to show the nexus of the applicant with alleged seizure of banned Tobacco articles namely 'Gutka'. 2 6 aba 510.2021.2021 4. It says that, the Police have seized a huge stock of Gutka pouches from two co-accused, who are already arrested. Further, it is revealed that, when the Police inquired with the arrested accused, they discloses names of some persons from whom the banned articles were purchased. admittedly, applicant's name was not disclosed by the co-accused. 5. It is pointed that since the Police were visiting the applicant's place for arrest, initially, he has applied to the Court of Sessions for grant of pre-arrest bail by filing Misc. Criminal Application No.638 of 2021. The relevant order discloses that since the applicant/accused was not added as an accused, the Court has granted 48 hours protection to the applicant. Thereafter, the applicant received a notice on which he again move to the Court of Sessions for pre-arrest bail by Criminal Bail Application No.697 of 2021, which came to be rejected. Moreover, there were CDR to show the connection. As of now, there is no material against the applicant.
